subline: The date, one search bar, and a shortcut button. A small tip shows the way.

headline: Your apps, by category
subline: Tap one to open it. The apps you use most come first.

headline: One bar for apps and the web
subline: Type to find an app, or press Go to search. Blauncher never goes online.

headline: The date and a shortcut
subline: Your calendar, and any app you choose for the button. Hold either to change it.

headline: Long-press for settings
subline: Help, feedback, and an order that learns on your phone only.

subline: Plus answers to the usual questions.
